facts.fact: Lonestar MTN and Orange Liberia operate mobile-money platforms, which the Inclusive Instant Payment System connected from December 2025.

The Inclusive Instant Payment System, launched December 2025, connects Lonestar MTN and Orange Liberia mobile money for real-time interoperability, and processed over 1.5 million transactions worth over L$1.4 billion and US$9 million in its first three months, per Finance Minister Ngafuan.
